# Written by internal/cmd/schemagen. Do not edit.
#
# Every exported Go name generation produces, one per line, sorted. The
# transitive $ref closure of manifest.json is 168 of the schema's
# definitions; exported_test.go holds the package's exports against this list.
#
# A name marked UNSTABLE comes from a definition carrying upstream's UNSTABLE
# marker. Those symbols are exempt from this module's compatibility guarantee,
# so a gorelease finding against one is reviewed rather than blocking.
